info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Operational Service Processing Order-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of operational service processing orders within the banking sector. It enables businesses to efficiently manage and initiate service requests, ensuring that orders are processed seamlessly. Typical consumers of this API include banking operations teams and financial service providers looking to streamline their service workflows. By integrating this functionality, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and improve service delivery to clients.

post.summary: Process an order within operational services.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to process a specific order through the operational services system. It handles all necessary validations and initiates the order processing workflow.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the processing of an operational order. The provided data must align with the required schema, including all necessary fields to ensure proper processing of the order.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses bearer tokens for authentication.
